name: GPUTime
description: Time this API command took to execute on the GPU in nanoseconds from the time the previous command reached the bottom of the pipeline (BOP) to the time this command reaches the bottom of the pipeline (BOP). Does not include time that draw calls are processed in parallel.

name: ExecutionDuration
description: GPU command execution duration in nanoseconds; from the time the command enters the top of the pipeline (TOP) to the time the command reaches the bottom of the pipeline (BOP). Does not include time that draw calls are processed in parallel.

name: ExecutionStart
description: GPU command execution start time in nanoseconds. This is the time the command enters the top of the pipeline (TOP).

name: ExecutionEnd
description: GPU command execution end time in nanoseconds. This is the time the command reaches the bottom of the pipeline (BOP).

name: GPUBusy
description: The percentage of time the GPU command processor was busy.

name: GPUBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the GPU command processor was busy.

name: TessellatorBusy
description: The percentage of time the tessellation engine is busy.

name: TessellatorBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the tessellation engine is busy.

name: VsGsBusy
description: The percentage of time the ShaderUnit has VS or GS work to do in a VS-[GS-]PS pipeline.

name: VsGsBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the ShaderUnit has VS or GS work to do in a VS-[GS-]PS pipeline.

name: VsGsTime
description: Time VS or GS are busy in nanoseconds in a VS-[GS-]PS pipeline.

name: PreTessellationBusy
description: The percentage of time the ShaderUnit has VS and HS work to do in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessellationBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the ShaderUnit has VS and HS work to do in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessellationTime
description: Time VS and HS are busy in nanoseconds in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessellationBusy
description: The percentage of time the ShaderUnit has DS or GS work to do in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessellationBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the ShaderUnit has DS or GS work to do in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessellationTime
description: Time DS or GS are busy in nanoseconds in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PSBusy
description: The percentage of time the ShaderUnit has pixel shader work to do.

name: PSBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the ShaderUnit has pixel shader work to do.

name: PSTime
description: Time pixel shaders are busy in nanoseconds.

name: CSBusy
description: The percentage of time the ShaderUnit has compute shader work to do.

name: CSBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles that the ShaderUnit has compute shader work to do.

name: CSTime
description: Time compute shaders are busy in nanoseconds.

name: GSVerticesOut
description: The number of vertices output by the GS.

name: VsGsVALUInstCount
description: Average number of vector ALU instructions executed for the VS and GS in a VS-[GS-]PS pipeline. Affected by flow control.

name: VsGsSALUInstCount
description: Average number of scalar ALU instructions executed for the VS and GS. Affected by flow control.

name: PreTessVALUInstCount
description: Average number of vector ALU instructions executed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation. Affected by flow control.

name: PreTessSALUInstCount
description: Average number of scalar ALU instructions executed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation. Affected by flow control.

name: PreTessVALUBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime vector ALU instructions are being processed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessVALUBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles vector where ALU instructions are being processed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessSALUBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime scalar ALU instructions are being processed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessSALUBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles where scalar ALU instructions are being processed for the VS and HS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PreTessVerticesIn
description: The number of vertices processed by the VS and HS when using tessellation.

name: PostTessPrimsOut
description: The number of primitives output by the DS and GS when using tessellation.

name: PostTessVALUInstCount
description: Average number of vector ALU instructions executed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation. Affected by flow control.

name: PostTessSALUInstCount
description: Average number of scalar ALU instructions executed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation. Affected by flow control.

name: PostTessVALUBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime vector ALU instructions are being processed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessVALUBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles vector where ALU instructions are being processed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessSALUBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime scalar ALU instructions are being processed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PostTessSALUBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles where scalar ALU instructions are being processed for the DS and GS in a pipeline that uses tessellation.

name: PrimitiveAssemblyBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime that primitive assembly (clipping and culling) is busy. High values may be caused by having many small primitives; mid to low values may indicate pixel shader or output buffer bottleneck.

name: PrimitiveAssemblyBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the primitive assembly (clipping and culling) is busy. High values may be caused by having many small primitives; mid to low values may indicate pixel shader or output buffer bottleneck.

name: PrimitivesIn
description: The number of primitives received by the hardware. This includes primitives generated by tessellation.

name: CulledPrims
description: The number of culled primitives. Typical reasons include scissor; the primitive having zero area; and back or front face culling.

name: ClippedPrims
description: The number of primitives that required one or more clipping operations due to intersecting the view volume or user clip planes.

name: PAStalledOnRasterizer
description: Percentage of GPUTime that primitive assembly waits for rasterization to be ready to accept data. This roughly indicates for what percentage of time the pipeline is bottlenecked by pixel operations.

name: PAStalledOnRasterizerCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the primitive assembly waits for rasterization to be ready to accept data. Indicates the number of GPU cycles the pipeline is bottlenecked by pixel operations.

name: PSPixelsOut
description: Pixels exported from shader to color buffers. Does not include killed or alpha tested pixels; if there are multiple render targets; each render target receives one export; so this will be 2 for 1 pixel written to two RTs.

name: PSExportStalls
description: Pixel shader output stalls. Percentage of GPUBusy. Should be zero for PS or further upstream limited cases; if not zero; indicates a bottleneck in late Z testing or in the color buffer.

name: PSExportStallsCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the pixel shader output stalls. Should be zero for PS or further upstream limited cases; if not zero; indicates a bottleneck in late Z testing or in the color buffer.

name: CSThreadGroupsLaunched
description: Total number of thread groups launched.

name: CSWavefrontsLaunched
description: The total number of wavefronts launched for the CS.

name: CSThreadsLaunched
description: The number of CS threads launched and processed by the hardware.

name: CSThreadGroupSize
description: The number of CS threads within each thread group.

name: CSVALUInsts
description: The average number of vector ALU instructions executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSVALUUtilization
description: The percentage of active vector ALU threads in a wave. A lower number can mean either more thread divergence in a wave or that the work-group size is not a multiple of the wave size. Value range: 0% (bad); 100% (ideal - no thread divergence).

name: CSSALUInsts
description: The average number of scalar ALU instructions executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSVFetchInsts
description: The average number of vector fetch instructions from the video memory executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSSFetchInsts
description: The average number of scalar fetch instructions from the video memory executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSVWriteInsts
description: The average number of vector write instructions to the video memory executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSGDSInsts
description: The average number of GDS read or GDS write instructions executed per work item (affected by flow control).

name: CSLDSInsts
description: The average number of LDS read/write instructions executed per work-item (affected by flow control).

name: CSALUStalledByLDS
description: The percentage of GPUTime ALU units are stalled by the LDS input queue being full or the output queue being not ready. If there are LDS bank conflicts; reduce them. Otherwise; try reducing the number of LDS accesses if possible. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

name: CSALUStalledByLDSCycles
description: The average number of GPU cycles the each wavefronts' ALU units are stalled by the LDS input queue being full or the output queue being not ready. If there are LDS bank conflicts; reduce them. Otherwise; try reducing the number of LDS accesses if possible.

name: CSLDSBankConflict
description: The percentage of GPUTime LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

name: CSLDSBankConflictCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the LDS is stalled by bank conflicts. Value range: 0 (optimal) to GPUBusyCycles (bad).

name: TexUnitBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime the texture unit is active. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

name: TexUnitBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the texture unit is active. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

name: TexTriFilteringPct
description: Percentage of pixels that received trilinear filtering. Note that not all pixels for which trilinear filtering is enabled will receive it (e.g. if the texture is magnified).

name: TexTriFilteringCount
description: Count of pixels that received trilinear filtering. Note that not all pixels for which trilinear filtering is enabled will receive it (e.g. if the texture is magnified).

name: NoTexTriFilteringCount
description: Count of pixels that did not receive trilinear filtering.

name: TexVolFilteringPct
description: Percentage of pixels that received volume filtering.

name: TexVolFilteringCount
description: Count of pixels that received volume filtering.

name: NoTexVolFilteringCount
description: Count of pixels that did not receive volume filtering.

name: TexAveAnisotropy
description: The average degree of anisotropy applied. A number between 1 and 16. The anisotropic filtering algorithm only applies samples where they are required (e.g. there will be no extra anisotropic samples if the view vector is perpendicular to the surface) so this can be much lower than the requested anisotropy.

name: DepthStencilTestBusy
description: Percentage of time GPU spent performing depth and stencil tests relative to GPUBusy.

name: DepthStencilTestBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles spent performing depth and stencil tests.

name: HiZTilesAccepted
description: Percentage of tiles accepted by HiZ and will be rendered to the depth or color buffers.

name: HiZTilesAcceptedCount
description: Count of tiles accepted by HiZ and will be rendered to the depth or color buffers.

name: HiZTilesRejectedCount
description: Count of tiles not accepted by HiZ.

name: PreZTilesDetailCulled
description: Percentage of tiles rejected because the associated prim had no contributing area.

name: PreZTilesDetailCulledCount
description: Count of tiles rejected because the associated primitive had no contributing area.

name: PreZTilesDetailSurvivingCount
description: Count of tiles surviving because the associated primitive had contributing area.

name: HiZQuadsCulled
description: Percentage of quads that did not have to continue on in the pipeline after HiZ. They may be written directly to the depth buffer; or culled completely. Consistently low values here may suggest that the Z-range is not being fully utilized.

name: HiZQuadsCulledCount
description: Count of quads that did not have to continue on in the pipeline after HiZ. They may be written directly to the depth buffer; or culled completely. Consistently low values here may suggest that the Z-range is not being fully utilized.

name: HiZQuadsAcceptedCount
description: Count of quads that did continue on in the pipeline after HiZ.

name: PreZQuadsCulled
description: Percentage of quads rejected based on the detailZ and earlyZ tests.

name: PreZQuadsCulledCount
description: Count of quads rejected based on the detailZ and earlyZ tests.

name: PreZQuadsSurvivingCount
description: Count of quads surviving detailZ and earlyZ tests.

name: PostZQuads
description: Percentage of quads for which the pixel shader will run and may be postZ tested.

name: PostZQuadCount
description: Count of quads for which the pixel shader will run and may be postZ tested.

name: PreZSamplesPassing
description: Number of samples tested for Z before shading and passed.

name: PreZSamplesFailingS
description: Number of samples tested for Z before shading and failed stencil test.

name: PreZSamplesFailingZ
description: Number of samples tested for Z before shading and failed Z test.

name: PostZSamplesPassing
description: Number of samples tested for Z after shading and passed.

name: PostZSamplesFailingS
description: Number of samples tested for Z after shading and failed stencil test.

name: PostZSamplesFailingZ
description: Number of samples tested for Z after shading and failed Z test.

name: ZUnitStalled
description: The percentage of GPUTime the depth buffer spends waiting for the color buffer to be ready to accept data. High figures here indicate a bottleneck in color buffer operations.

name: ZUnitStalledCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the depth buffer spends waiting for the color buffer to be ready to accept data. Larger numbers indicate a bottleneck in color buffer operations.

name: DBMemRead
description: Number of bytes read from the depth buffer.

name: DBMemWritten
description: Number of bytes written to the depth buffer.

name: CBMemRead
description: Number of bytes read from the color buffer.

name: CBColorAndMaskRead
description: Total number of bytes read from the color and mask buffers.

name: CBMemWritten
description: Number of bytes written to the color buffer.

name: CBColorAndMaskWritten
description: Total number of bytes written to the color and mask buffers.

name: CBSlowPixelPct
description: Percentage of pixels written to the color buffer using a half-rate or quarter-rate format.

name: CBSlowPixelCount
description: Number of pixels written to the color buffer using a half-rate or quarter-rate format.

name: L0CacheHit
description: The percentage of read requests that hit the data in the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data; which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

name: L0CacheRequestCount
description: The number of read requests made to the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data; which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L0CacheHitCount
description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data; which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L0CacheMissCount
description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the L0 cache. The L0 cache contains vector data; which is data that may vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: ScalarCacheHit
description: The percentage of read requests made from executing shader code that hit the data in the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

name: ScalarCacheRequestCount
description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code to the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: ScalarCacheHitCount
description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache hit from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: ScalarCacheMissCount
description: The number of read requests made from executing shader code which result in a cache miss from the Scalar cache. The Scalar cache contains data that does not vary in each thread across the wavefront. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: InstCacheHit
description: The percentage of read requests made that hit the data in the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

name: InstCacheRequestCount
description: The number of read requests made to the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: InstCacheHitCount
description: The number of read requests which result in a cache hit from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: InstCacheMissCount
description: The number of read requests which result in a cache miss from the Instruction cache. The Instruction cache supplies shader code to an executing shader. Each request is 64 bytes in size.

name: L1CacheHit
description: The percentage of read or write requests that hit the data in the L1 cache. The L1 cache is shared across all WGPs in a single shader engine. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

name: L1CacheRequestCount
description: The number of read or write requests made to the L1 cache. The L1 cache is shared across all WGPs in a single shader engine. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L1CacheHitCount
description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache hit from the L1 cache. The L1 cache is shared across all WGPs in a single shader engine. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L1CacheMissCount
description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache miss from the L1 cache. The L1 cache is shared across all WGPs in a single shader engine. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L2CacheHit
description: The percentage of read or write requests that hit the data in the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU; including the Command Processor; Geometry Engine; all WGPs; all Render Backends; and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (no hit) to 100% (optimal).

name: L2CacheMiss
description: The percentage of read or write requests that miss the data in the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU; including the Command Processor; Geometry Engine; all WGPs; all Render Backends; and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (all miss).

name: L2CacheRequestCount
description: The number of read or write requests made to the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU; including the Command Processor; Geometry Engine; all WGPs; all Render Backends; and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L2CacheHitCount
description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache hit from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU; including the Command Processor; Geometry Engine; all WGPs; all Render Backends; and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L2CacheMissCount
description: The number of read or write requests which result in a cache miss from the L2 cache. The L2 cache is shared by many blocks across the GPU; including the Command Processor; Geometry Engine; all WGPs; all Render Backends; and others. Each request is 128 bytes in size.

name: L0TagConflictReadStalledCycles
description: The number of cycles read operations from the L0 cache are stalled due to tag conflicts.

name: L0TagConflictWriteStalledCycles
description: The number of cycles write operations to the L0 cache are stalled due to tag conflicts.

name: L0TagConflictAtomicStalledCycles
description: The number of cycles atomic operations on the L0 cache are stalled due to tag conflicts.

name: FetchSize
description: The total bytes fetched from the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

name: WriteSize
description: The total bytes written to the video memory. This is measured with all extra fetches and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

name: MemUnitBusy
description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalled). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account. Value range: 0% to 100% (fetch-bound).

name: MemUnitBusyCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is active. The result includes the stall time (MemUnitStalledCycles). This is measured with all extra fetches and writes and any cache or memory effects taken into account.

name: MemUnitStalled
description: The percentage of GPUTime the memory unit is stalled. Try reducing the number or size of fetches and writes if possible. Value range: 0% (optimal) to 100% (bad).

name: MemUnitStalledCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the memory unit is stalled.

name: WriteUnitStalled
description: The percentage of GPUTime the Write unit is stalled. Value range: 0% to 100% (bad).

name: WriteUnitStalledCycles
description: Number of GPU cycles the Write unit is stalled.

name: LocalVidMemBytes
description: Number of bytes read from or written to the Infinity Cache (if available) or local video memory

name: PcieBytes
description: Number of bytes sent and received over the PCIe bus

name: RayTriTests
description: The number of ray triangle intersection tests.

name: RayBoxTests
description: The number of ray box intersection tests.

name: TotalRayTests
description: Total number of ray intersection tests; includes both box and triangle intersections.

name: RayTestsPerWave
description: The number of ray intersection tests per wave.
